items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: He come up and he used to make a lot of trips with us, too.

ctx.x: When did he come up to New York? Ellington's father?
After we got settled in the Kentucky Club. He come up and he used to make a lot of trips with us, too.
Oh, he used to travel with the band a lot?
